description: A finite partition of the naturals into infinite pairwise disjoint pieces is a maximal almost disjoint family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.maximal_finite_partition.{u} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (A : ι → Set ℕ)
  (hinf : ∀ (i : ι), (A i).Infinite) (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) (hc : ⋃ i, A i = Set.univ) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsMaximalAlmostDisjoint (Set.range A)
